answer: In this PoA network, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so sustained honest service is required to rebuild weight after inactivity or equivocation. EigenTrust normalization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity leave freshly spawned Sybil identities with near-zero eigenvector centrality: an isolated island at the trust nadir, unable to influence or pass consensus. Even a violet collusion ring cannot bootstrap credibility without trusted links.
